ios._comment_supportsTablet: false on purpose. The UI has no iPad handling at all — no size-class or useWindowDimensions branching, and three maxWidth rules in the whole app — so a 13-inch iPad gets phone layout stretched full-bleed. Declaring iPad support obliges us to supply iPad screenshots and invites review on a device the app was never designed for (Guideline 4.0). iPhone apps still run on iPad in compatibility mode. Flip this only alongside real iPad layout work.
ios._comment_entitlements: Time Sensitive Notifications lets a reminder push break through Focus and skip the scheduled notification summary — without it iOS may sit on a 9:00 reminder for hours. Only the reminder push asks for it (pushService interruptionLevel); the weekly digest deliberately does not. Native capability: it takes a new EAS build, an OTA update won't pick it up.

infoPlist._comment_NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Set explicitly, and duplicated in the expo-audio plugin options below, because expo-audio otherwise fills in its generic default ('Allow Offload to access your microphone') — the weakest string in the binary for a voice-first app, and the kind review flags under Guideline 5.1.1. An existing infoPlist value wins over the plugin default, so either alone would do; both are set to keep them from drifting apart.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Offload records your voice so you can talk instead of type. Your recording is transcribed into notes and isn't kept afterward.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Offload uses your location to find the right nearby place when you mention one in a note — so "milk at Safeway" means the Safeway near you.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Offload checks on your phone whether you've arrived somewhere you left yourself a note, so it can remind you when it's useful. Your location isn't continuously tracked or uploaded.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Offload checks on your phone whether you've arrived somewhere you left yourself a note, so it can remind you when it's useful. Your location isn't continuously tracked or uploaded.
